meta_title: Spinney Hill Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Northampton
meta_description: Spinney Hill Plumbing in Northampton offers emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response, qualified engineers, no call-out charge on repairs.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or blocked drain in Northampton? Our engineers arrive fast, usually within an hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to new installations, we handle all plumbing work for homes and small businesses.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to get you sorted the same day.

services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently. Emergency callouts available for breakdown.

services.title: Central Heating Installation

services.title: Bathroom Suites & Wet Rooms
services.desc: Full installation from pipework to tiling. We handle the lot and leave you with a finished, waterproof space.

about_pullquote: I started this business because my own dad was let down by a dodgy plumber.
about_para_1: Spinney Hill Plumbing was founded 18 years ago in Northampton with one goal: honest pricing and reliable work. We've grown to a tight team of four fully qualified engineers, each with over a decade's experience. Every job, big or small, gets the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing the job right first time, and treating your home with respect. We don't charge call-out fees on repair jobs, and we give you a fair price before we start. Repeat customers make up 70% of our work — that's how we know we're getting it right.
reviews_heading: What Northampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a burst pipe in the kitchen. Steve arrived before midnight, sorted it out and made sure everything was safe before he left. Would've been a nightmare if he hadn't picked up. Top bloke, fair price too.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed last month. The lads were professional, tidy, and explained everything as they went. Boiler's running beautifully and the paperwork was all done properly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Been using Spinney Hill for drain cleaning twice now. Both times they arrived on time, got the job done without fuss, and didn't overcharge. That's rare these days. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: David P.
